system.description:
[Trigger: Setup] "Target: Wide Area 20 (Select)/Range: Close" to use on allies other than yourself. Targets whose [HP] is less than half of their [Maximum HP] gain 1 point of [Fate]. Once per scene. The sword said to have been passed down from an unfortunate swordsman. Its blade is polished smoothly, reflecting light like a mirror. When it reflects a scene of misfortune, those who see it are said to attract their own fate, as if their misfortune were mirrored. However, it is forbidden to look at oneself in this sword. The reason is unknown.

Cracked Mirror Board [Core Material] (180G) + Saber (230G) + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (320G)
